name: Additive lydian organ
desc: An additive sine-partial organ drone: fast overlapping arpeggios ring into sustained chords (long release), breathing through a bright C-lydian arc (Cmaj7 / D / Em7 / Gmaj) as the harmonic spectrum thickens from sparse to peak and a glacial filter and pan keep it in slow motion.

cut.doc: lpf center Hz — the swell orbits around this

code.full: note("<[c3 e3 g3 b3] [d3 f#3 a3 c4] [e3 g3 b3 d4] [g3 b3 d4 f#4]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").partials([1,.6,.4,.3,.2]).attack(.05).decay(.3).sustain(.85).release(2.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}*1.4).slow(24)).lpq(1).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(28)).gain(${gain}).shape(.5).room(${room}).orbit(6).play()
code.peak: note("<[c3 e3 g3 b3 f#4] [d3 f#3 a3 c4 e4] [e3 g3 b3 d4 f#4] [g3 b3 d4 f#4 a4]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").partials([1,.7,.5,.4,.35,.25,.2]).attack(.05).decay(.25).sustain(.85).release(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.9).slow(16)).lpq(1).off(1/2, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.45)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(20)).gain(${gain}).shape(.5).room(${room}).orbit(6).play()
